description.value: Waves Coffee House is a Vancouver-born specialty coffee chain founded in 2005, built around 100% Specialty Grade Arabica beans and real Belgian chocolate in its signature mochas. The downtown Howe Street location offers indoor and outdoor seating, a bookable private meeting room with a smart TV and power outlets, and a food menu spanning sandwiches, wraps, soups, and pastries. Takeout, online ordering, and DoorDash delivery make it a flexible stop in the heart of the city.
